body: Owner asked (2026-11-10) to update all docs from the guide to the CLI and improve them. Scope: WP8 items in docs/review-followups.md, the CLI --help sweep item from WP10, and an accuracy pass over docs/guide/*, README.md, packages/cli/README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md against the built CLI (including WP1 behaviour). History files (progress, decisions, ideas, review-followups) stay as records.

completion.releaseNote: `sati decision delete` accepts a short handle, and command help states limits, defaults and exit codes.
completion.summary: WP8 done: deleted docs/handoff.md (decision recorded), marked AGENT_KICKOFF.md as history, ADR 0004 for the stack as built, PLAN drift fixed (packages, e2e/guard, unbuilt CI/release items, Phase 0, settled decisions), team-brain, README/quick-start/FAQ/SECURITY/security-review/CONTRIBUTING fixed; guides describe WP1 behaviour. WP10 help sweep: ~35 help strings state limits, defaults and exit codes; fixed decision delete by short handle with a CLI test. Gate: core 303, store-sqlite 53, sync 52, mcp 26, ui 21, cli 147.

title: Review follow-ups WP8 + CLI help sweep: docs from guide to CLI
